tagline: The engine without the supporting cast.
file: A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
The schedule. His 501.76 points against are the most in the league, and he has scored at least 110 every week.
Whether Bijan Robinson and the roster add one real depth piece before the 0-3 turns into a pick.

2026.headline: Bijan can't do it alone, and the schedule is not helping
story: Sarge71 is 0-3 with points that would win in a weaker schedule: 145.00 in Week 1, which lost to C33DeezNutzz's 195.82, 110.60 in Week 2 and 117.88 in Week 3. His points against are the highest in the league at 501.76, and his points for rank in the middle of the pack. The desk will call it bad luck, then note the pattern repeated.

The roster is Bijan Robinson and a supporting cast that cannot score. Robinson was the Week 1 MVP at 31.3 and the Week 3 MVP at 35.3. In Week 2, with Bijan quiet, the top scorer on the roster was Dalton Kincaid at 22.5. He cut Jaxson Dart, watched StealingGas bid $298 on him, and replaced him with Aaron Rodgers.
FAAB is untouched at $500, the efficiency is 84.7 percent, and the draft slot is the 1.04. The pick is useful, but the more useful move is a trade, and Sarge71 has not made one.
takes: Sarge has the engine and no supporting cast. That is the whole story.
A very good score wins most weeks. This was not most weeks.
